lines.trans: Hello, Vika, hi, are you home right now?
No, I am not home, why do you ask?
Oh, nothing, alright, lower me down!
What happened with your truck down there?
Something got jammed, do not worry, we will fix everything right now!
Folks, may I have everyone's attention for a minute!
So, as I understand it, you two are having a wedding soon.
Yes, Dmitry Vladimirovich, our wedding is soon.
My colleagues, friends, and I are very happy for you.
A new young and beautiful family is being born among us!
As a generous man, I am giving the best gift to the newlyweds.
So live happily, kids, harmony and love to you!
